3113-00575 TRANSFEROFDEVELOPMENT-RIGHTSANDNOTICEOFRESTRICTIONS NEW YORK BROADHURST THEATRE, LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office c/o The Shubert Organization, Inc., 234 West 44"h Street, New York, New York 10036 ("Theater Owner"), and ROSELAND DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATES, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office c/o Algin Management Co. LLC, 183 Madison Avenue, Suite 1602,NewYork,NewYork 10016 ("Purchaser"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Theater Owner is the owner of the Broadhurst Theatre, which is located on the real property in the City, County and State of New York designated as part of Lot 11 of Block 1016 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and by the street address 235 West ,      s) (, a ok an os a  a and the Land and the Theater, the “Premises"), the Land being more particularly described in Exhibit A attached hereto; and WHEREAS, Theater Owner operates the Theater as a theater; and WHEREAS, Theater Owner is the owner of all the real property described in WHEREAS,the Real Property is located in the Theater·Subdistrict, as such term is defined in Section 81-70 et seq. of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the "Zoning Resolution"), and the Theater is designated in Section 81-742 of the Zoning Resolution as Listed Theater; and WHEREAS,the Theater Owner seeks to transfer the Excess Floor Area Development Rights to a parcel owned by Purchaser located at 239 West 52nd Street (Block 1024, Lot 52) in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York (the “Receiving Site"), the Receiving Site being more particularly described in Exhibit B attached hereto; and WHEREAS theReceivingSite is located within the Theater Subdistrict(as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution); and WHEREAS, such a transfer of development rights from a Listed Theater within the Theater Subdistrict to another site is governed by the provisions of Section 81-74 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, the transfer of the Excess Floor Area Development Rights from the Premises'to the Receiving Site requires a certification by the City Planning Commission ("CPC") pursuant to Section 81-744 of the Zoning Resolution (the “Certification"), and KL3 2933518.4

WHEREAS,PurchaserdesirestoreceivefromTheaterOwner,andTheater OwnerdesirestotransfertoPurchaser,theExcessFloorAreaDevelopmentRights NOW,THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained, it is hereby agreed as follows: “Floor Area Development Rights”shall mean the development rights,as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot byerecting thereon a structure or structures with a totalFloor Area(as hereinafterdefined)determined(A)bymultiplyingtheareaofthezoninglotby themaximum allowable floor area ratio (as hereinafter defined) for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, (B) by the inclusion of any available “bonus” floor area, and (C) by the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of The City of NewYork from time to time. “ExcessFloor Area Development Rights"shall mean1,182 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Theater Zoning Lot. The terms “Floor Area”, “floor area ratio", “zoning lot", “"parties in interest", "use” and “bulk” shall have the meanings set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. Theater Owner hereby conveys, assigns, transfers and sets over to Purchaser the Receiving Site. This conveyance is made subject to the trust fund provisions of Section 13 of the New York Lien Law. At the request and expense of Purchaser, Theater Owner covenants that it will execute or procure any further necessary assurances of its rights to make the within transfer. Notice is hereby given that this transfer (a) irrevocably restricts the available floor area appurtenant to the Theater Zoning Lot by reducing the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant thereto by 1,182 square feet of floor area, and (b) benefits the Receiving Site by feetoffloorarea. Theater Owner covenants that at no time shall any building, buildings or improvements be situated on the Theater Zoning Lot which would have a floor area in excess'of the floor area permitted thereon pursuant to the Zoning Resolution or any amendments thereof. If there is enacted an amendment to the Zoning Resolution which reduces thefloor area permitted on the Theater Zoning Lot, all buildings and improvements situated on the Theater ZoningLot at the time of such amendment maybe continued irrespective of their existingfloor area,but shall not be enlarged or otherwise modified so as to result in floor area in excess of the amount permitted on the Theater Zoning Lot at such time or, if the then-existing floor area is already in excess of the amount permitted on the Theater Zoning Lot, increase the degree of such excess. -2- KL3 2933518.4
